_description: VASCULAR ACCESS ASSESSMENT TOOL scenario — form payload for tests/vascular-access.spec.ts. Filled into the Vascular Access Assessment form (load/visit-form/{visitId}/vascular-access-assessment, opened from the visit edit page's 'VASCULAR ACCESS ASSESSMENT TOOL' tab) of the target visit (visitId from config/config.json → vascularAccess.visitId). Static values are chosen from the real option lists / checkbox ids on staging; the access type is Arteriovenous Fistula (AVF) so the AVF branch (site, date, access-type checkbox, needle-insertion scoring checkboxes) applies and the catheter bundle (f_*/g_*) is intentionally absent. Scoring checkbox values are their input ids (no labels exist); intervention checkbox values are their LABEL texts (what the readback returns); select values are the option texts; radio values are Yes/No. The visit ID itself is NOT here — it lives in config/config.json so all tests share one value.

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.

_fields.lowEducateAccessCare: Educate patient & caregiver on access care
